app.title: Ledger / Pricing & Cost Laboratory
app.marketNote: Student-entered unit sales are assumptions, not forecasts. The United States is a working market assumption where no launch geography is stated.

sourceConflict.message: The supplied materials describe two different ventures. Choose the context you want to model. Mission 1 pricing is relevant to the Quick-Fold Mat; the live original website is a Google Nara Tee concept, and its $32 page price is not a validated competitor benchmark.

nara-tee.name: Google Nara Tee
nara-tee.concept: A one-time apparel concept: a deep-brown everyday T-shirt with a small chest wordmark, positioned for curious, early-career, and creative people.
nara-tee.customers: The website speaks to the curious, the just-starting, and the always-making; creators, students, early-career people, and people building side projects are working customer hypotheses.
nara-tee.value: A familiar mark, rethought as a personal everyday tee; claimed price $32 USD on the concept website.
nara-tee.distribution: The site links to Google Merch for checkout. No independent storefront, supplier agreement, licensing permission, or fulfillment plan is documented.
nara-tee.geography: U.S. dollar price shown; customer geography and shipping region are not stated.
nara-tee.legalRisk: The concept uses Google brand elements on a shirt. Google's public brand guidance says not to use Google brand elements on merchandise; it permits use for school projects. No commercial permission is documented in the provided files. Treat the product as a class concept unless authorization or a different design is established.

products.name: Google Nara Tee
products.description: Deep-brown short-sleeve concept tee with a small white chest wordmark. Exact garment, fabric, size range, and decoration method are not specified on the site.

expenses.name: Shirt + one print placement
expenses.description: Published reference for one printed Gildan 5000 tee. It may not match the Nara concept's garment, shade, sizes, or decoration specification.

reference.meaning: Displayed price for one Gildan 5000 with one print placement; varies by size, color, print, tax, and shipping.

expenses.assumptions: Use as a supplier benchmark only, not a quote for the exact design or Google Merch fulfillment.

expenses.name: Supplier shipping to buyer
expenses.description: Starting U.S. shipping reference for a Gildan 5000 order. Actual rate depends on destination, item count, delivery method, and supplier route.

reference.meaning: Published 'shipping starts at' figure, not a universal rate.

expenses.assumptions: Assumes the venture pays this shipping cost; if the buyer pays shipping, adjust revenue/expense treatment to match checkout.

expenses.name: Domestic card fee
expenses.description: Standard Stripe online domestic-card fee used as a comparison assumption; no processor is confirmed for this concept site.

reference.meaning: 2.9% plus a separate $0.30 per successful domestic card transaction.

expenses.assumptions: Applied only if a direct Stripe-like checkout is used; the original site currently links out to Google Merch.

expenses.name: Card fee per transaction
expenses.description: Fixed component of the published Stripe standard domestic-card price.

reference.meaning: Fixed part of 2.9% + $0.30 domestic card fee.

expenses.assumptions: Processor choice is not confirmed. Do not add if the marketplace takes its own fee instead.

expenses.name: Returns / replacement allowance
expenses.description: Editable reserve for refunds, reships, and quality issues. No venture return data was provided.
expenses.assumptions: Set to 2% only as an editable example, not an industry average or researched return rate.

expenses.name: Launch marketing
expenses.description: Paid outreach, creator samples, or creative testing budget. No approved campaign or media quote is documented.
expenses.assumptions: Editable planning amount; do not infer sales lift from additional marketing spend.

expenses.name: Domain and web tools
expenses.description: Optional domain, email, and basic storefront tools; the existing page is hosted on GitHub Pages, but the sales channel and future commerce platform are unconfirmed.
expenses.assumptions: Does not include a paid ecommerce platform or custom domain contract.

expenses.name: Founder time / labor
expenses.description: Optional compensation for design, customer service, order administration, and launch work. No hours or wage target was provided.
expenses.assumptions: Zero means not yet costed, not free labor.

expenses.name: Brand permission / design clearance
expenses.description: No license fee is quoted. The source is an official policy warning, not a paid license offer. Google's current guidance says not to use its brand elements on merchandise and separately permits school-project use.
expenses.assumptions: Zero is an unpriced placeholder, not evidence of permission or a $0 commercial license. Keep this issue visible before commercial sale.

expenses.name: Pre-production sample
expenses.description: One sample at the current published supplier reference cost plus its starting shipping reference. Samples should be reviewed for color, fit, fabric, print, and wash durability.

reference.meaning: Arithmetic sum of the Gildan 5000 displayed $9.44 and starting U.S. shipping $4.95.

expenses.assumptions: A sample is not a recurring expense; additional test rounds may be needed.

expenses.name: Commercial brand license fee
expenses.description: No commercial license or authorization cost is documented. Google brand guidance states not to use Google elements on merchandise; the fee is unpriced and no permission is implied.
expenses.assumptions: Do not treat zero as a valid license quote. Educational mockup and commercial sale are different uses.

nara-tee.researchStatus: Mission 1 dataset concerns folding boards and is not a valid T-shirt competitor set.
nara-tee.disclaimer: The $32 price appears on the original venture concept page. It is not a validated retail price, a proof of a Google partnership, or a verified competing offer.

quickfold-mat.name: Quick-Fold Laundry Sorting Mat
quickfold-mat.sourceLabel: Mission 1 venture overview and competitor research
quickfold-mat.concept: A portable, hinged garment-folding mat intended to make laundry folding faster, more consistent, and usable in small spaces.
quickfold-mat.customers: College students and dorm residents, young professionals in small apartments, busy parents, travelers and RV/van-life users, seniors, and gift buyers. These are venture-brief segments, not validated demand.
quickfold-mat.value: Magnetic latches, anti-slip surface, portable panels, and uniform folding are proposed differentiators; no prototype or performance test is documented.
quickfold-mat.distribution: Online marketplace and ecommerce are possible channels; no channel, supplier, or manufacturing partner is confirmed.
quickfold-mat.geography: United States online market is a working assumption from Mission 1.
quickfold-mat.legalRisk: Brand name, launch location, manufacturer, product dimensions, and customer validation are not supplied.

products.name: Quick-Fold Laundry Sorting Mat
products.description: Portable hinged folding mat concept with magnetic latches and anti-slip material. Exact design, dimensions, BOM, and manufacturing method are unvalidated.

expenses.name: Board materials, magnets, hinges & assembly
expenses.description: Bundled per-mat manufacturing placeholder covering panels, hinges, magnetic catches, assembly, and basic quality checks. No BOM or supplier quote is available.
expenses.assumptions: Teaching placeholder only. Replace with a written supplier quote, target specification, minimum order quantity, and defect allowance.

expenses.name: Inbound freight & receiving
expenses.description: Freight from contract manufacturer to the selling or fulfillment location; volume, origin, carton size, and Incoterms are unknown.
expenses.assumptions: No carrier or supplier quote. Costs can change materially with order volume and package dimensions.

expenses.name: Protective retail packaging
expenses.description: Packaging and insert placeholder for a rigid or semi-rigid foldable product shipped to consumers.
expenses.assumptions: Needs an actual package design and supplier quote. Dimensional weight may raise outbound costs.

expenses.name: Outbound shipping to buyer
expenses.description: Estimated shipping burden for a folded board. No dimensions, weight, service, or destination mix are documented.
expenses.assumptions: Not a carrier quote. Enter the actual rate or pass-through shipping collected at checkout.

expenses.name: Domestic card fee
expenses.description: Standard Stripe online domestic-card fee shown as an example payment channel; processor not selected.

reference.meaning: 2.9% plus $0.30 per successful domestic card transaction.

expenses.assumptions: Use only if direct checkout uses this rate. Marketplace commissions are different and not included.

expenses.name: Card fee per transaction
expenses.description: Fixed part of the Stripe standard domestic card fee.
expenses.assumptions: No payment processor confirmed.

expenses.name: Returns, defects & replacements
expenses.description: Reserve for returns, damage, failed latches, and replacement shipments. No product trial data exists.
expenses.assumptions: 3% is an editable assumption, not a verified category return rate.

expenses.name: Launch marketing
expenses.description: Flexible paid acquisition, creator content, or launch creative budget. No campaign plan or channel quote is available.
expenses.assumptions: An editable planning input. Spending does not automatically increase demand in this model.

expenses.name: Admin & bookkeeping
expenses.description: Optional software or outside bookkeeping for a small online product venture; no provider or jurisdiction is selected.
expenses.assumptions: Illustrative allowance, not a quote or business requirement.

expenses.name: Founder labor
expenses.description: Optional compensation for sourcing, quality checks, customer support, fulfillment, and business administration.
expenses.assumptions: Zero means founder labor has not been valued. Do not equate this with free labor.

expenses.name: Prototype, samples & usability testing
expenses.description: One-time material, prototype, and fit-for-purpose user testing allowance; no design or supplier quote is available.
expenses.assumptions: Placeholder for one iteration, not an industry benchmark. Actual prototype method and test plan may cost more.

expenses.name: Tooling or production setup
expenses.description: No quote for molds, dies, cutting fixtures, or production setup is available. A zero value is only an unpriced placeholder.
expenses.assumptions: Enter a supplier quote and, if capitalized, a useful-life assumption before treating this as included in break-even.

expenses.name: Safety, durability & quality testing
expenses.description: Prototype validation for panel cycles, latch strength, edge safety, grip, packaging, and wear; no lab quote or product standard is documented.
expenses.assumptions: Placeholder only; not a statement of required certification or actual test cost.
